description: chinamaxM Claude host hooks (ADR 0005/0007/0009). SubagentStart injects the numbered Worker contract (complete-final-report duty) into a spawned chinamaxM Worker; PreToolUse(Agent) injects the verbatim no-attribution Relay rule into the dispatching parent; SessionStart runs the warn-only proxy-port check (points at /chinamaxM:doctor when the env flip is present but the port is dead). Matching is anchored and Registry-derived in Python — SubagentStart carries NO static matcher because Overlay Profiles are dynamic. All fail open (exit 0, no injection) on any internal fault.
